sam (People Ops): Heads-up — need an expedited comp-band exception for a candidate relocating from EU -> US. Hiring manager & recruiter pushed for a closed offer; comp conversion pushes them above the normal band cap. Routing guidance?

ashley (Recruiter): Candidate: Gabriel Park. Current offer in GBP is £90,000 plus £10k relocation. If we convert at current FX it maps to ~$122k which is L5 band max, but manager wants to match with a $10k sign-on to make total comp competitive. Candidate prefers a May 15 start but can be flexible.

sam (People Ops): Summary of ask: approve $10k sign-on + one-time relocation top-up outside standard band for headcount 9873. Need approvals from Finance + Exec Comp. Prefer 48hr turnaround if possible.

ashley (Recruiter): Quick numbers:```base_usd_equiv = 122000
requested_signon = 10000
relocation_one_time = 10000
total_first_year_cash = 142000```

devon (Hiring Manager): +1 to approving sign-on. This role is mission critical for Q3 infra rollout; if we miss the candidate it'll delay timelines. Can we mark as urgent? @leah any budget flexibility? :pray:

leah (Finance): Need business justification + cost center code. Also run run-rate impact (salary + benefits) and one-time cash items. From quick glance: run-rate delta looks OK against team budget but I need final numbers and headcount approval doc. Please attach the offer doc and headcount approval.

anita (Legal): Note — moving comp from international payroll to US payroll has tax and benefits implications. If candidate signs as US employee, we must confirm start date + work authorization. Recommend hold the final effective start date until immigration confirms; we can still approve sign-on conditional on payroll conversion.

sam (People Ops): Routing plan: 1) Create approval ticket to Exec Comp committee 2) Attach offer + headcount memo + finance cost calc 3) Tag @exec-comp and legal 4) Ask for 48hr review window. I can draft the memo if you paste the offer.

ashley (Recruiter): Uploaded offer PDF to /files/GPark-offer.pdf and added headcount memo in google doc: https://docs.internal/gpark-headcount. Candidate prefers earliest possible start but understands visa may push it.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-4721. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-4721

leah (Finance): Received the docs. I ran the quick calc and posted a snapshot in the doc. We can sign off on the sign-on if headcount is confirmed and recruiting covers the one-time relocation GL string. I'll post final approval once the cost center is verified.

devon (Hiring Manager): Thanks — marking role as urgent in my calendar. If exec comp needs more context, happy to join a 15-min sync.

sam (People Ops): Great. Next steps: I'll ping exec-comp in 2h and flag APPR-4721 for 48hr turnaround. If approval is granted we should set start date as "pending immigration" and template the offer with the conditional sign-on clause.

ashley (Recruiter): Noted — will update candidate communication to say start date is tentatively May 15 pending immigration and approval.

sam (People Ops): tagging final watchers: @devon, @leah, @anita — please react with :thumbsup: when you made your internal approval note so I can close the loop on this thread.

(devon) :thumbsup:
(leah) :thumbsup:
(anita) :thumbsup:
